prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1236; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision took place?
A: It was on a multi-lane highway in Katy, Texas, in the right lane heading toward the center of town. Traffic was moving steadily, maybe around forty miles an hour.
Q: Walk me through what happened right before the impact.
A: I was moving over from the right lane into the middle lane because I needed to get to an exit. I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and signaled. As I started to shift over, another car came up alongside me and clipped the side of my vehicle.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not really. It was in my blind spot, and I didn't see it until I heard the scrape and felt the jolt.
Q: Did either of you stop afterward?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and we exchanged information.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?
A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to the left. My lower back aches too, and it's worse when I sit for long stretches. I'm taking over-the-counter pain relievers and I've scheduled a visit with my doctor.
Q: Did you seek medical attention at the scene or afterward?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon, and they diagnosed me with neck and back strain. They recommended rest and some physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was trying to drive carefully and I'm willing to provide any photos or paperwork you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
